## @kit/compose-autoscaler
export type Attempt<T> = {
    readonly type: 'done';
    readonly value: T;
} | {
    readonly type: 'failed';
    readonly reason: string;
};
export interface AutoscalerConfig {
    readonly metricsPath: string;
    readonly stages: Readonly<Record<string, ScalerStageConfig>>;
}
export interface AutoscalerOptions {
    metricsUrl: string;
    composeFile?: string;
    dryRun?: boolean;
    pollIntervalMs?: number;
    stageConfigs: Record<string, ScalerStageConfig>;
    logger: Logger;
    executor: (cmd: string) => Promise<Attempt<unknown>>;
    fetcher: (url: string) => Promise<Attempt<string>>;
    now: () => number;
}
export interface CliHost {
    argv: readonly string[];
    env: Env;
    executor: AutoscalerOptions['executor'];
    fetcher: AutoscalerOptions['fetcher'];
    now: AutoscalerOptions['now'];
    onSignal: (signal: 'SIGINT' | 'SIGTERM', handler: () => void) => void;
    exit: (code: number) => void;
    print: (text: string) => void;
    log: Logger;
}
export class ComposeAutoscaler
  constructor(options: AutoscalerOptions): ComposeAutoscaler
  getStates: () => Map<string, StageScalingState>
  start: () => void
  stop: () => void
  tick: (nowMs: number) => Promise<void>
export interface ComputeReplicasParams {
    config: ScalerStageConfig;
    state: StageScalingState;
    queueDepth: QueueDepth;
    nowMs: number;
}
export interface QueueDepth {
    waiting: number;
    prioritized: number;
    active: number;
    completed?: number;
    failed?: number;
    delayed?: number;
}
export interface ScalerStageConfig {
    minReplicas: number;
    maxReplicas: number;
    threshold: number;
    cooldownSeconds: number;
}
export interface ScalingDecision {
    targetReplicas: number;
    action: 'scale_up' | 'scale_down' | 'hold';
    reason: string;
    nextState: StageScalingState;
}
export interface StageScalingState {
    currentReplicas: number;
    lastScaleDownTimeMs: number;
    scaleDownCandidateSinceMs: number | null;
}
export function computeReplicas(params: ComputeReplicasParams): ScalingDecision
export function isScalerStageConfig(value: unknown): value is ScalerStageConfig
export function parsePrometheusQueueMetrics(prometheusText: string): Record<string, QueueDepth>
export function run(config: AutoscalerConfig, host: CliHost): void
